about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a web developer with experience in creating modern websites and web applications. I'm passionate about clean code, intuitive interfaces and efficient solutions.
about.p2: I have worked on various projects, from landing pages to complex systems, always seeking the best user experience and development best practices.

services.title: Services
services.intro: I offer complete digital solutions, from design to deployment, with a focus on clean code and user experience.
services.service1_desc: Complete development of websites and web applications, from frontend to backend, with modern and scalable technologies.
services.service2_desc: Development and customization of WordPress themes, plugin implementation and optimization of existing sites.
services.service3_desc: Creation of online stores with payment gateway integration and inventory management systems.
services.service4_desc: Design and development of landing pages optimized for conversion, with responsive design and fluid animations.
services.service5_desc: Ongoing support, security updates, automatic backups and website performance optimization.
services.service6_desc: Search engine ranking improvement, loading speed optimization, performance analysis and implementation of security measures based on OWASP Top 10.
